argv:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$(uv tool dir --bin):$PATH"
mkdir -p outputs/synthetic_data_generation/profile/court-assets-verify/setup
TIMEFORMAT="elapsed_seconds=%R"
time uv sync --locked
time MAX_JOBS=2 .venv/bin/python -m spin setup-nht --render-only
nht-render --help
nvidia-smi > outputs/synthetic_data_generation/profile/court-assets-verify/setup/gpu.txt
nvcc --version > outputs/synthetic_data_generation/profile/court-assets-verify/setup/cuda.txt
uv tool list > outputs/synthetic_data_generation/profile/court-assets-verify/setup/tools.txt
git rev-parse HEAD
git -C third_party/nht rev-parse HEAD
